summary: Valuence Merger Corp. I filed an 8-K reporting a restructuring of related-party debt via mutual termination of a zero-drawn note and an omnibus exchange agreement. Existing notes and advances totaling $1.87M were cancelled in exchange for three new interest-free convertible notes (aggregate principal up to $6M, initial drawdown $1.87M). The new notes mature upon business combination or liquidation. No price, premium, or board advisor is cited. This is a balance-sheet housekeeping filing without a change-of-control or strategic catalyst—not a special situation event.
